sample_cited_answer.query: What is the minimum fire resistance rating required for walls separating a boiler room from other parts of a building?
sample_cited_answer.answer: Under Clause 6.1.1.2 of the National Building Code of India, walls separating a boiler room from other parts of a building must provide a minimum fire resistance rating of 120 minutes (2 hours) [1]. All exterior and interior openings connecting to the boiler room must be protected by self-closing fire doors having an equivalent fire resistance rating of not less than 120 minutes [1] [Volume 1, PDF p. 314-315].
